scripts.deploy: python3 scripts/sync.py && astro build && wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name xjtu-math-materials --branch production --commit-dirty=true
scripts.feedback: wrangler d1 execute xjtu-math-feedback --remote --command "SELECT id, datetime(created/1000,'unixepoch','+8 hours') AS 时间, title AS 资料, cls AS 班型, term AS 学期, teacher AS 任课, note AS 其他 FROM feedback WHERE status='new' ORDER BY id"
